A '''frogeel''' is a hybrid of a [[giant frog]] and a [[raw cave eel]]. Players may create frogeels in the [[Creature Creation]] basement dungeon under the [[Tower of Life (building)|Tower of Life]] once they complete the [[Tower of Life]] quest.

A frogeel is created by using one pair of [[giant frog legs]] and a [[raw cave eel]] on the frogeel altar of life found in the western part of the basement. Upon activation of the altar, the [[Homunculus]] in the dungeon then creates the monster, which appears near the altar and will attack the player.

Creating and killing a frogeel is required for the [[It Just Croaked]] task in the [[Ardougne achievements#Hard achievements|hard Ardougne achievements]].
